; Session-scoped fast-monochrome reading toggle for color OS 3.27.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled: false
            property int rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval: 10
            property int rmtoolFastMonoCleanupCount: 0
            property int rmtoolFastMonoLastPage: -1
            property string rmtoolFastMonoLastDocumentId: ""
            readonly property bool rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable: !!document
                && (document.fileType === Document.Pdf
                    || document.fileType === Document.Ebook)
                && EPFramebuffer.hasCapability(EPFramebuffer.Capability.Color)

            function rmtoolResetFastMonoCleanup() {
                rmtoolFastMonoCleanupCount = 0
                rmtoolFastMonoCleanupTimer.stop()
            }

            Timer {
                id: rmtoolFastMonoCleanupTimer
                interval: 500
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (root.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable
                        && root.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled
                        && root.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval > 0) {
                        root.ghostBuster.forceClearNow("rmtool fast mono periodic cleanup")
                    }
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root

                function onCurrentPageChanged() {
                    const page = root.currentPage
                    const documentId = root.document ? root.document.id.toString() : ""
                    if (documentId !== root.rmtoolFastMonoLastDocumentId) {
                        root.rmtoolFastMonoLastDocumentId = documentId
                        root.rmtoolResetFastMonoCleanup()
                        root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage = page
                        return
                    }
                    if (page < 0 || root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage < 0) {
                        root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage = page
                        return
                    }
                    if (page === root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage) {
                        return
                    }
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage = page
                    if (!root.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable
                        || !root.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled
                        || root.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval <= 0) {
                        return
                    }
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupCount += 1
                    if (root.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupCount
                        >= root.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval) {
                        root.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupCount = 0
                        rmtoolFastMonoCleanupTimer.restart()
                    }
                }

                function onDocumentChanged() {
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoLastDocumentId = ""
                    root.rmtoolResetFastMonoCleanup()
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage = -1
                }

                function onRmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabledChanged() {
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoLastDocumentId = root.document
                        ? root.document.id.toString() : ""
                    root.rmtoolResetFastMonoCleanup()
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage = root.currentPage
                }

                function onRmtoolFastMonoCleanupIntervalChanged() {
                    root.rmtoolResetFastMonoCleanup()
                    root.rmtoolFastMonoLastPage = root.currentPage
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar#toolbar
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolDocumentView: root
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root > Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolFastMonoReadingToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolFastMonoReadingToggle"
                label: "\u5feb\u901f\u9ed1\u767d"
                visible: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable ?? false
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled ?? false
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled = !view.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled
                    view.showNotification({
                        message: view.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled
                            ? "\u5feb\u901f\u9ed1\u767d\u5df2\u5f00\u542f"
                            : "\u5feb\u901f\u9ed1\u767d\u5df2\u5173\u95ed"
                    })
                }
            }

            Component {
                id: rmtoolFastMonoCleanupOptions

                ColumnLayout {
                    spacing: 0

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "\u6bcf 5 \u6b21\u7ffb\u9875"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval === 5
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval = 5
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "\u6bcf 10 \u6b21\u7ffb\u9875"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval === 10
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval = 10
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "\u6bcf 20 \u6b21\u7ffb\u9875"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval === 20
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval = 20
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "\u6bcf 30 \u6b21\u7ffb\u9875"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval === 30
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval = 30
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "\u4ece\u4e0d"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval === 0
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval = 0
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                id: rmtoolFastMonoCleanupSelector
                objectName: "rmtoolFastMonoCleanupSelector"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled ?? false)
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                label: "\u5f3a\u5236\u5237\u65b0"
                description: {
                    const interval = root.toolbar.rmtoolDocumentView?.rmtoolFastMonoCleanupInterval ?? 10
                    return interval > 0 ? "\u6bcf " + interval + " \u6b21\u7ffb\u9875" : "\u4ece\u4e0d"
                }
                onClicked: stackView.push(rmtoolFastMonoCleanupOptions)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#globalScreenMode
        REPLACE visible WITH {
            visible: {
                if (!documentView.item) {
                    return false
                }
                if (documentView.visible
                    && documentView.item.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable
                    && documentView.item.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled) {
                    return true
                }
                const mode = documentView.item.globalScreenMode
                return mode !== undefined
            }
        }
        REPLACE mode WITH {
            mode: {
                if (documentView.visible
                    && documentView.item?.rmtoolFastMonoReadingAvailable
                    && documentView.item.rmtoolFastMonoReadingEnabled) {
                    return Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Mono
                }
                if (documentView.item && documentView.item.globalScreenMode) {
                    return documentView.item.globalScreenMode
                }
                return Epaper.ScreenModeItem.UI
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
